Apple’s (AAPL) Neutral Rating Reiterated at HSBC Posted by Donald Scott | Jan 31st, 2019
HSBC restated their neutral rating on shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) in a report released on Wednesday morning. The firm currently has a $160.00 price objective on the iPhone maker’s stock.
AAPL has been the subject of a number of other reports. JPMorgan Chase & Co. restated a buy rating and set a $272.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, October 10th. BidaskClub downgraded Apple from a hold rating to a sell rating in a report on Wednesday, November 28th. Needham & Company LLC lowered their price target on Apple from $200.00 to $180.00 and set a buy rating for the company in a report on Thursday, January 3rd. Sanford C. Bernstein reiterated a neutral rating and issued a $210.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Friday, November 2nd. Finally, Morgan Stanley reiterated an overweight rating and issued a $253.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Thursday, November 15th. Three research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have given a hold rating and twenty-two have given a buy rating to the company. The company has an average rating of Hold and an average price target of $191.66. Get Apple alerts:
Shares of AAPL stock traded up $2.79 on Wednesday, reaching $168.04. 645,050 shares of the stock were exchanged, compared to its average volume of 36,307,028. The company has a market cap of $819.48 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 14.14, a PEG ratio of 1.49 and a beta of 1.23. The company has a quick ratio of 1.09, a current ratio of 1.12 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87. Apple has a 1-year low of $142.00 and a 1-year high of $233.47.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, January 29th. The iPhone maker reported $4.18 EPS for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $4.17 by $0.01. The business had revenue of $84.31 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $84.07 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 51.09% and a net margin of 22.72%. As a group, analysts expect that Apple will post 11.89 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
The business also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 14th. Stockholders of record on Monday, February 11th will be given a dividend of $0.73 per share. The ex-dividend date is Friday, February 8th. This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a dividend yield of 1.74%. Apple’s payout ratio is 24.52%.
In other news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Monday, November 19th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the transaction, the insider now owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $1,698,600. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through the SEC website . Company insiders own 0.05% of the company’s stock.
Hedge funds have recently modified their holdings of the company. Fosun International Ltd increased its stake in shares of Apple by 25.3% during the fourth quarter. Fosun International Ltd now owns 12,250 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,911,000 after acquiring an additional 2,470 shares during the period. NF Trinity Capital Hong Kong Ltd increased its stake in shares of Apple by 3.6% during the fourth quarter. NF Trinity Capital Hong Kong Ltd now owns 85,714 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $13,521,000 after acquiring an additional 2,949 shares during the period. Sonata Capital Group Inc. increased its stake in shares of Apple by 5.6% during the fourth quarter. Sonata Capital Group Inc. now owns 16,842 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,657,000 after acquiring an additional 890 shares during the period. Lucas Capital Management increased its stake in shares of Apple by 1.2% during the fourth quarter. Lucas Capital Management now owns 31,725 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $5,004,000 after acquiring an additional 384 shares during the period. Finally, Carnick & Kubik Group LLC increased its stake in shares of Apple by 1.4% during the fourth quarter. Carnick & Kubik Group LLC now owns 69,556 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $10,972,000 after acquiring an additional 981 shares during the period. 57.02% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors and hedge funds.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
